android.title: Tarantal Madness for Android
android.test_build: Test build for friends: not from a store, and it may have bugs.
android.step1: Open this page on your Android phone and tap the download button.
android.step2: Open the downloaded file (from the notification or your Downloads).
android.step3: If Android asks, allow installing apps from this source (your browser or file manager), then go back and tap Install.
android.step4: Open Tarantal Madness from your home screen. It works offline: every picture and sound is inside the app.
android.update: A newer version installs over the old one and keeps your progress.
android.missing: No app has been built for this version yet. Try again later.
android.iphone: No iPhone app yet: play in Safari and add the game to your home screen.
